Judgement relies on the manifest/runtime/packet bindings being the authentic host-bound artifacts as asserted by the environment.
rationale: The change adds two linked, narrowly-scoped mechanisms and is internally consistent with the brief. (1) modal_volume_path.bound_root binds only the literal '/volume' provider alias to a controller-recorded Volume ID (regex vo-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,80}), requiring the alias be a symlink resolving exactly to /__modal/volumes/<id>, all ancestors be real directories (lstat S_ISDIR, so symlinked ancestors fail), and performs TOCTOU-stability rechecks of (dev,ino,mtime_ns) and resolved target/stat identity. It relaxes nothing in private_records: every child write still uses the unchanged no-symlink, owner-only, no-hardlink writer, and the launcher commits the canonical Volume root (volume_commit(osroot)). The provider launch now passes volumes['data'].object_id as argv[4] and the launcher pins len(sys.argv)==4. (2) modal_mount_recovery authenticates one exact chain (fab901a1 -> db2121f0): it verifies the predecessor config/schema/source/release/units/install, the original binding/handle/FAILED records, the empty-Volume terminal proof by exact field+hash (exit 1, empty stdout, STDERR_SHA256, zero file count/bytes/mutations), and a fresh replacement package whose schema/attempt/plans/authority/patient flag and cohort bytes are byte-identical to the old package (only executable bytes change). Budget.reserve now uses predecessor_ids (a set, {original.PARENT, PARENT}) so both prior UNCERTAIN rows are excluded from the 'already prepared / uncertain asset' guards while both reserved costs still count in the unchanged item4 SMOKE_CAP/TOTAL_CAP and headroom checks; no new allowance is introduced. resolved_failure_ids closes only the two ancestors on a verified child via ancestor_ids and refuses overlap (DIRECT_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_CHILD); a failed or pending child, any other uncertain row, changed binding/content, or reused source all refuse (check_child requires the child source to differ from BOTH ancestors and to use the new package hash). live_empty recurses through the ancestor so both terminal/empty-Volume attempts are proven, with per-attempt expected exit/stream hashes. The rehearsal (private byte copies, live DB not opened, 0 ledger writes, 0 provider ops, 0 model calls) and all three suites (focused 219 passed; full-pytest 5881 passed/42 skipped; full-orchestration 214 OK) are green at the reviewed source_sha with model_calls=0. Privacy is preserved: raw provider evidence is referenced by hash only and proofs are compared by digest rather than quoted. Authority is the existing item4 direct-download approval and charter; the draft is not installed and launches nothing. Remaining gates (live suites, genuine approval, held promotion, fresh provider proof, actual billing) are explicitly future and fail-closed. The acknowledged limitations are inherent to a pre-launch engineering fix and do not constitute test-set leakage, code/spec mismatch, metric error, privacy/secret exposure, budget violation, or provenance/authority overreach, so no finding is warranted.
